packages/plugins/realtime-layer/src/laye.name: ok

packages/plugins/realtime-layer/src/publ.name: ok

packages/plugins/realtime-layer/src/real.name: ok

Le typecheck le voit, mais aucune passe visant les lignes `import`/`vi.mock` ne l’atteint.
